items.question: When will you arrive?
items.answer: You'll get an estimated arrival window. We do our best to stay within it, though weather, traffic, or prior jobs can occasionally cause slight delays.

items.question: How often will you service my lawn?
items.answer: We offer weekly and bi-weekly service, and you can adjust, pause, or cancel anytime with a quick message.

items.question: What should I do before you arrive?
items.answer: Unlock gates, secure pets, and clear toys, hoses, and other obstacles from the lawn. Please also mark any sprinkler heads or hidden hazards.

items.question: What if my grass is really tall?
items.answer: Significantly overgrown lawns may need extra time, multiple passes, or a first-cut service instead of a standard mow — we'll always confirm pricing with you first.

items.question: Do I need to be home?
items.answer: Not at all — as long as gates are unlocked and pets are secured, we can service your property while you're away.

items.question: How do I pay?
items.answer: Payment is due on completion of service. We accept card, cash, and Cash App, with easy online payment options available.

items.question: What if I'm not happy with the service?
items.answer: Let us know within 48 hours and we'll review it and make it right. We take pride in every property we service.

items.question: What's your cancellation policy?
items.answer: We ask for at least 24 hours' notice to cancel or reschedule a visit whenever possible.

items.question: What if you can't access part of my yard?
items.answer: Locked gates, pets, or blocked access can mean an area gets skipped for that visit. Since our time and equipment are already committed to the job, this doesn't automatically reduce the scheduled price.

items.question: What happens if the weather affects my scheduled service?
items.answer: Weather, unsafe conditions, or equipment issues can occasionally push a visit back a day or two. We complete service as soon as conditions safely allow and let you know if your date changes.

items.question: Is my address in your service area?
items.answer: We serve Rowan County and surrounding areas, including Kannapolis, Concord, China Grove, Landis, Salisbury, and Enochville. Coverage can depend on your exact location and route, so let us know your address when requesting a quote and we'll confirm.

items.question: How does the referral program work?
items.answer: You'll earn $10 off once the person you referred completes their first service. Credits can stack up to $20 off in a single visit, with a max of 10 referral credits per calendar year. Unused credits expire December 31st.
